create_SequenceGeneratorTrainer: create a SequenceGeneratorTrainer instance for training the LSTM sequence generator part of SING with a decoder and truncated gradient size
train_SequenceGeneratorTrainer_batch: train a SequenceGeneratorTrainer batch using truncated backpropagation through time over embedding sequences
get_rebuilt_target_SequenceGeneratorTrai: get rebuilt waveform and target from a SequenceGeneratorTrainer by passing embeddings through the decoder
create_SINGTrainer: create a SINGTrainer instance for training the entire SING model end-to-end
get_rebuilt_target_SINGTrainer: get rebuilt waveform and target from a SINGTrainer by running the full model forward pass on a batch
